name: Vintage Cartoon
traits: faded early colour or sepia-toned monochrome
aged film print marks: dust, scratches, flicker, gate weave
painted watercolour backgrounds behind flat inked figures
bestFor: short loops with a strong rhythm
suits: food, drink, cleaning, household and heritage products; cheerful, nostalgic, mischievous brands
stylePara: A mid-century theatrical cartoon print that has aged: characters with simple rounded forms, oval eyes with small pupils and expressive brows, inked in a confident black line with slight thick-thin variation and filled with flat gouache colour; the palette has faded and shifted on the print, warm reds turned salmon, greens toward teal, whites toward cream; backgrounds are soft painted plates with dry-brush texture behind the crisp inked figures; the whole image carries film age: fine grain, dust specks, a few vertical scratches, slight exposure flicker and a soft rounded vignette.

rendering.line: bold uniform black ink line, perfectly closed shapes, simple circles and curves; no line weight variation
rendering.shading: flat fills with almost no shadow; at most a simple drop shadow on the floor
rendering.colour: faded two-strip palette (salmon, teal, cream, black) or sepia monochrome; the product kept recognisable in a faded version of its colours
rendering.texture: film grain, dust, scratches, light leaks at the edges, exposure flicker, slight gate weave
rendering.lighting: flat and even, like a cel lit on a camera stand; vignette darkens the corners

motion: Animated on ones and twos with springy rubber-hose bounce: characters idle in a constant rhythmic bob, limbs swing in smooth arcs without elbows, strong squash and stretch on every step; objects come alive and dance to the beat; the print jitters slightly in the gate.
camera: Static stage-like framing, characters playing to the front as on a stage; trucking moves in and out on the flat background; iris-in and iris-out to open and close; no perspective-changing moves.
avoid: clean sharp HD with no film wear
realistic anatomy with elbows and knees
title cards or lettering burned into the print
sheets: A model sheet in the period manner: front, three-quarter, side and two action poses in black line on a cream ground, with the head shape, eyes and costume fixed; then one coloured version in the faded palette; the product redrawn as a simple cartoon object in its faded colours.
risk: Seedance keeps the film wear but drifts back to modern clean colour and realistic hands, and it may write fake title cards into the scratched print; repeat 'faded print palette, flat gouache fills, aged film' and 'no lettering'. Avoid iconic early-cartoon traits (pie-cut eyes with white gloves): they read as one specific old character and image models refuse them.

example.prompt: Aged mid-century cartoon still: a woman in her thirties with a dark bun, oval eyes and an orange top in faded salmon, drawn in a bold black ink line with flat gouache colour, holds up a small faded-green glass bottle with a yellow cap; a sunny kitchen painted as a soft dry-brush background plate, a droopy cartoon fern on the windowsill; faded print palette, film grain, dust and scratches, soft vignette. Vertical 9:16. No text.
